description: This file declares an interface class IDataReader within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace, which provides a pure virtual method readData() returning a vector of media segments. It includes licensing information and references an external IMediaPipeline class.

classes.name: IDataReader
classes.description: An interface class defining a contract for reading media data, with a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method readData() returning a vector of media segments.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: A pure virtual method that, when implemented, reads and returns a vector of media segments.
